levels.surface: سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبي العمياء

notes: Sahl's father («دخل هو وأبوه», «قال أبي يرحمك الله») is in the scene and asks; he is not a link. Anas answers and relays the Prophet's words, so Anas is the last link.
«عمر بن عبد العزيز» names the time and place of the visit, not a transmitter.
